contract.oracle: Rigid parallel planes with overlapping perpendicular-strip XY projections; distance=abs(.4-.7*scale*t)
contract.first_contact: 3/7 at full scale; 6/7 at half scale; quarter scale is clear
contract.certificate: resolved CCD status AND full prefix certified; a numeric fraction alone is insufficient
contract.snapshot: deep copy points of all strands, velocities, every multiplier, and handle state; diagnostics remain outside physical-state hash
contract.reset_order: Restore accepted state first; then apply the normal per-step multiplier reset if that is the solver contract
contract.gravity_retry: For hanging failure, shorten timestep and recompute velocity/gravity prediction; halving a nonexistent handle advance changes nothing
contract.limits: Analytic fixture and injected mutable-state sentinels only; no native rollback implementation or general CCD tested

cases.candidate_rule: A z -= .1*scale; B z -= .8*scale, always from accepted state

expected.scope: Geometry/mutation injection fixture, not a prediction of coupled cloth's candidate positions

expected.policy: If retaining IterationLimit as top-level status, still preserve the original and report unresolved certification

expected.cache_policy: invalidate or restore geometry-dependent caches before retry
